newsitem.title: KENYA: Publishers, bank lift Nairobi bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Publishers, bank lift Nairobi bourse index.

text.p: Two deals on the one-hour hold special board for Nation Printers & Publishers and Kenya Commercial Bank lifted the Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index marginally, dealers said on Monday.
The index gained 17.77 points to close at 3418.90. Turnover was posted at 37.5 million shillings ($0.69 million) on 445,800 shares from 21.5 million shillings on 569,100 shares on Friday.
Nation Printers traded 93,800 shares at 175 from 166 while Kenya Commercial Bank traded 50,600 shares at 95 unchanged.
Brokers and bourse officials said despite the two deals on the special lots board, the market was on average very dull.
"Apart from the big trade, the rest of the market is generally down," a senior broker said.
They said the underlying mood was cautious ahead of the annual state budget provisionally planned for June 12.
Plantations Rea Vipingo eased to 8.55 from 9.0 while George Williamson traded at 69 unchanged.
Kenya Airways eased to 8.05 from 8.10 while Uchumi Supermarket shed a shilling to close at 40 from 41.
A broker said many investors were on hold while awaiting interim results of companies expected some time in June/July.
"Some of them also feel the shares are too low and would rather wait for them to gain more value," another broker said.

Brokers said illiquidity in the market was also to blame for the reduced buying activity by foreign funds. "We have big orders but the shares are just not available. So we have to buy the shares piecemeal," one said.

Barclays Bank fell 1.0 to 112, Standard Chartered Bank was unchanged at 46 and National Bank of Kenya rose to 16.45 from 15.40. Foreign investors bought National Industrial Credit Bank at 53 from 54.50.
Kenya Breweries was unchanged at 58 while Total Kenya shed a shilling to close at 71. Kenya Power & Lighting Corp edged up two shillings to close at 162.
